instructions: Put the 3 tbsp olive oil, 1/2 tsp balsamic vinegar, 1/4 tsp salt and 1/8 tsp pepper in a small jar, close it and shake until it turns cloudy.
Taste it, and add a pinch more salt if it's flat. Pour it into 4 small bowls, one each.
Trim the fennel, pull off any stringy outer layer and slice it into thin wedges.
Peel the carrots and cut them into sticks.
Cut the cucumber lengthwise into spears.
Trim 4 of the radishes and cut them in half.
Separate the endive into whole leaves.
Rinse the vegetables under cold water and pat them dry with a towel.
Arrange them on a platter. Serve with a bowl of the oil each.
method_notes: Both read versions set crisp raw vegetables such as fennel, carrots and celery or cucumber out on a platter with small bowls of seasoned extra virgin olive oil for dipping. The Clever Meal (listed first) uses 3 tbsp oil with a touch of balsamic or lemon, salt and pepper, while Manu's Menu mixes equal parts oil and red wine vinegar. Neither shows a rating, so this follows The Clever Meal's dressing and vegetables for 4, with the balsamic option.
